brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates safe clinical handling with all responsibility-chain items met, including thorough red-flag screening (RC1), correct recognition of OSA context (RC2), safe handling of coagulation concerns without overdiagnosis (RC4), and appropriate handoff with caregiver receipt (RC7). HO4 (dynamic reprioritization) is completed as the model visibly adapted from emergency screening to preoperative preparation to final countdown. HO1 (caregiver-friendly communication) is partially completed with structured checklists and plain language but limited teach-back verification. Grade 4 is appropriate: no chain errors plus one completed high-order point with meaningful trajectory impact.
